ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity (white/cream) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large, irregular low-intensity contiguous zone is centered at the peduncle insertion, bifurcating into the medial regions of both lobes. High-intensity pixels dominate the lateral lobe fields. Fine-scale low-intensity mottling and solid banding are clustered along the trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks varies, with notable clusters of larger serrations on the medial-half of each lobe and smaller, sharper peaks towards the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral margins, leading to sharply pointed distal tips before transitioning into the serrated trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-brown pixel staining observed on the lower medial surface of both lobes, positioned at the transition between the dark central region and the primary high-intensity fields.
